# `particle_voice/nn/kernels/ShaderComposer.js`

> **Source:** `agi/particle_voice/nn/kernels/ShaderComposer.js`

ShaderComposer.js — Phase 1 ParticleNN kernel infrastructure. WGSL chunk composition with dependency resolution: register named chunks (each optionally depending on other chunks), then compose an ordered, deduplicated concatenation for a kernel body — so e.g. `int8_pack`'s `unpack_int8` is emitted exactly once even if two requested chunks both depend on it, and always appears before any chunk/body that calls it.

## Functions

### `async createDefaultShaderComposer()`

Pre-registers the Phase 1 WGSL chunk set (`math_common`, `int8_pack`, `complex_math`) so a kernel generator can immediately `compose(['math_common', 'int8_pack'], body)` without registering each chunk itself. `f16_utils.js` has no WGSL fragment (it is a host-side-only JS<->f16 bit-conversion utility, per its own module doc) so it is not registered here.

## Notes & Examples

### Where this fits in the training loop

AGI runs an **observation → brain → action → reward** loop each tick: observations are gathered from the world, a brain maps them to actions, the rig applies motion, and rewards shape the next update.

**Example: Minimal training loop**
```js
import { Agent } from 'agi/core/Agent.js';
import { World } from 'agi/env/World.js';

const world = new World();
const agent = new Agent({
  brain: 'ppo',
  observationSpace: world.observationSpace,
  actionSpace: world.actionSpace
});

for (let step = 0; step < 10000; step++) {
  const obs = world.getObservation();      // Gather observations
  const action = agent.act(obs);            // Brain decides action
  const { reward, done } = world.step(action); // Apply action, get reward
  agent.learn(obs, action, reward);         // Update from experience
  
  if (done) world.reset();
}
```

**See also:** [AGI Training Guide](/agi/training-guide.md) · [AGI Architecture](/agi/architecture.md)
